relationships.subject: primary sensory neuron CB2 receptors

relationships.subject: LY2828360

relationships.subject: LY2828360
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with LY2828360 (0.03 or 0.1 mg/kg i.p.) beginning on day 7 of morphine administration reversed established morphine tolerance

relationships.subject: AM1710
relationships.evidence_quote: AM1710 decreased mRNA expression levels of IL-1β (p=0.057, Figure 6A), TNF-α (p=0.016, Figure 6B) and CCL2 (p=0.031, Figure 6C)

key_findings: CB2 agonists AM1710 and LY2828360 relieve ddC antiretroviral neuropathy in both sexes; effect absent in global CB2 KO and sensory-neuron CB2 conditional KO mice.
LY2828360 prevents and reverses morphine tolerance, requiring CB2 on peripheral sensory neurons.
